note: The obituary "Send flowers" fallback: a Florist One affiliate link, used only when the obituary's funeral home has no known florist page (data/funeral-homes.json). affiliateId is empty until Sam joins the program; with no ID the link goes to fallbackUrl instead: Florist One's public funeral-flowers page, no affiliate code, no "paid link" label, rel="noopener nofollow" (checked: it answered 200 on Oct 18, 2026). Set fallbackUrl to "" to hide the link again when there is no florist page and no ID. The server env var FLORIST_ONE_AFFILIATE_ID, when set, wins over affiliateId. affiliateUrl is the link with {id} replaced by the ID. Its shape is the one Florist One's own published affiliate links use (https://www.floristone.com/index.cfm?AffiliateID=<id>&source_id=aff); the signup page doesn't show it before joining. TODO: once joined, replace affiliateUrl with the exact link Florist One gives in its affiliate area (its agreement says not to change the links it provides).

tree.note: The obituary "Plant a tree" link, used when the funeral home has no treeUrl in data/funeral-homes.json. fallbackUrl is One Tree Planted's public Gift Trees In Memory page (a nonprofit; no affiliate code, unpaid, no "paid link" label, rel="noopener nofollow"; checked: it answered 200 on Oct 21, 2026). Set it to "" to hide the link when there is no tree page. affiliateId stays empty; TREE_AFFILIATE_ID on the server wins over it. affiliateUrl is empty on purpose: we don't know the program's link shape, so fill it in (with {id}) only from the program's own affiliate area. With an ID and an affiliateUrl the link is labeled "paid link" and rel="sponsored noopener", like flowers.
